title: Research: exact five-source connector optimum for all 36 positive tariffs
body:
## Result

For the generic immutable-source, one-dirty-connector F2 interface with five sources and all31 nonzero output masks, this proves the exact complete-map cost for every36 independently positive source/readout prices:

`OPT = 2 sum(b_j) + 2 sum(a_m) + 2 min({b_0,...,b_4} union {a_m : popcount(m)=3 or5})`.

Exactly16 componentwise minimal call profiles exist over **all finite legal words**. Each starts with two calls per map and adds two calls to one of five sources or eleven heavy-odd-mask readouts. All16 profiles have literal74-call dirty-state witnesses and each is uniquely exposed by positive rational prices. A cheap even-mask readout cannot absorb the surcharge: all prices10 except a_3=1 gives722, not704; changing the cheap mask to31 attains704.

## Why the word-length domain is complete

Every active map count is even and at least two. Any word with at least12 source events has a source count at least four and is componentwise dominated by an explicit repeated-source witness. Exactly10 source events reduce to945 canonical pairings; each misses a weight3-or5 mask and therefore needs at least four readouts of that output. Both singleton-missing weight orbits are attained. Thus no longer schedule can beat the16-vector frontier. Two code-disjoint engines compare all29295 readout costs, including42 six-readout cases rather than capping them at four.

The new result is the entire36-variable tariff theorem and irredundant frontier, not those inherited mechanisms or another unit-query census. Exact heads, SHA256/Git-blob pins and attribution are in SOURCES.json.

Independent chooser seed9c083f6b391fc18192cb0990085ca4ed; recursive-interfaces; connector-alphabet-change. Scope explicitly **changed**: no operation alphabet is extended, so this is a caller-tariff oracle side result, not success at the original mechanism gate. No supplier occurrence, complete physical tariff, recursive moment gain, new kappa, selected frontier edit or formal-kernel claim. Word-dependent admission, preparation, dispatch and routing remain separately charged. Final live overlap found PR2056 pair-source calls and PR2050 output-bank-mixing erasure, distinct contracts/results documented in README.

- `uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/connector-all-tariff-optimum` passed:945pairings,16profiles,3552dirty-basis forward/inverse case pairs,9semantic controls,4behavioral tests including live-source/receipt corruption, no-overwrite receipts and optimized read-only noGit relocation.
